coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and taking a morning shower
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
Getting dressed in work clothes and checking phone for shift updates
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
Taking an evening shower and washing up

Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV with the light dimmed and keeping high-power appliances off during the warned evening peak blackout window
Checking phone and computer, charging devices in case of a rolling blackout later tonight
Brushing teeth and completing night hygiene routine
